title: halal certification as an alternative source of economic growth: a bibliometric analysis
core_idea: Perform a bibliometric analysis of literature on halal certification (2003–2022) to assess its potential as an alternative source of economic growth across multiple sectors (food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, tourism, logistics), map research trends and thematic areas, and provide insights useful for policymakers, researchers, and practitioners.
tldr: A bibliometric study of halal certification literature (2003–2022) aiming to evaluate its economic potential and identify key research themes—consumer behaviour, certification processes, ethical considerations, and industry opportunities—to inform policy and future research.
